body.statement: Can the endpoint-safe coarsening handle in Definition \(\mathrm{def:coarsening-handle}\) be completed to derive a single implementable \(\pi^\star\in\Pi_{T,B}\) and a constant \(C<\infty\), depending only on the fixed envelopes, such that for every even \(T\ge32\), \(B\ge1\), and \(P\in\mathcal P_{\beta,d}(L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\), \[T^{-1}\mathbb E_{P,\xi}[C_g(M_{\pi^\star})-O_g(X)]\le CF_\alpha(T,b)?\] The construction must certify the hard cap and terminal emptying pathwise while deriving, rather than assuming, the clearance tail or an equivalent expected workload bound.
body.justification: This is the genuine open content: adapted inherited residues must be cleared without a false independence or de-Poissonization step.
body.gap: Ascher et al. use branching of order \(\log T\) without a cap, while Kanoria replenishes supply and delay-matching papers price waiting; none yields fixed-branching endpoint safety for this depleting reservoir.
body.consumer: A solution closes the all-regime capacity frontier and gives SeqExpMatch-style software a principled forced-clearing schedule.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct and prove a uniform endpoint-safe multiscale workload bound strong enough to charge emergency clearing by the frontier harmonic sum while retaining arrival-incidence matching and a deterministic hard cap.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen coarsening handle specifies neither phase lengths nor a proved recursion for inherited cell workloads. At fixed sample size those workloads are dependent, and density lower bounds alone do not justify independent-cell clearance or the asserted exponential tail. The capped grid proof pays one arbitrary-cost edge per residual cell, which is too large in the deadline-dominated regime.
obligation.attempted: I derived the exact cell update bound after a merge and examined geometric phase schedules. They control ordinary within-cell edges, but a proof still needs a concentration or workload contraction argument for residues inherited across levels; naive per-cell binomial bounds do not close because inherited loads are history-dependent and correlated.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved capped-grid construction gives
\[
R_T(B)\le C\inf_{1\le m\le b}\{m^{-\alpha}+m/T\},
\]
with deterministic cap compliance and terminal emptying.  Together with the proved lower theorem, this matches \(F_\alpha(T,b)\) whenever \(b^{1+\alpha}\le T\).  What remains is an expected multiscale workload or clearance bound that replaces the terminal \(m/T\) charge in the complementary regime.
